Repeated adaptive validation can overfit the selection criterion; the winning score is optimistic, even with fixed seeds ([Cawley–Talbot](https://www.jmlr.org/beta/papers/v11/cawley10a.html)). Applied plan: predeclare search ranges, evaluation checkpoints, promotion rules and tie-breaking; count checkpoint selection as additional search. Allocate the shared 43,200 GPU-seconds across four single-GPU slots, including failures and diagnostics; reserve enough to finish finalists. Successive halving can screen configurations at increasing training budgets, retaining all four datasets and identical validation users/candidates at every comparison ([Hyperband](https://jmlr.org/papers/v18/16-558.html)). Select by the required macro HR@10; log every trial, checkpoint, category score and compute cost.

For descriptive uncertainty, save each model’s binary hit per validation user. Bootstrap 200 users with replacement independently within each category, using identical resampled indices for both models; compute each category’s mean hit difference and average the four differences. Report the observed macro difference, percentile 95% interval, category differences and discordant-user counts. One changed hit moves category HR by 0.5 percentage points and macro HR by 0.125 points. These intervals describe user-sampling uncertainty conditional on the fitted models, fixed candidates and four categories; they exclude training-seed and negative-sampling variability and do not correct adaptive winner selection. Treat finalist intervals as exploratory; use the host’s untouched held-out evaluation for final assessment.

Label results explicitly as HR@10 against 99 fixed negatives. Sampled ranking metrics can reverse full-catalog model comparisons, so do not interpret benchmark gains as full-catalog gains or change the pinned evaluator ([Krichene–Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/)). Keep simulator recommendations and training-history diagnostics separate from the selection metric; avoid further validation-driven tuning after freezing the winner.
